first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The figure in the center of the passage with their back to the camera, wearing a dark brown top, a light gray-white hanging cloth, a yellow-ochre long cloth strip, and dark boots, and carrying a round shield and longbow on their back.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: The light-colored elevated stone-paved passage leading from the lower part of the image to the distant gateposts, referring only to the walkable surface.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: The black cage brazier beside the parapet wall on the left side of the passage, with a cage frame that is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom and orange flames inside.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: The closely spaced fence of slender gray-brown wooden stakes along the right side of the passage, with uneven tops.

entities.name: wood-roofed courtyard
entities.identification: The courtyard on the right side of the passage with a roof of wooden poles, orange-brown covering panels, support posts, and a low wall.

entities.name: tower-wall complex
entities.identification: The complex composed of distant reddish-brown gateposts, a long wall, towers, and open shelters.

entities.name: stone building complex
entities.identification: The small, square, light ochre-gray building by the water on the left and similar buildings behind it.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: The light ochre to reddish-brown rock face, terrace, and rocks within the source range in the upper-left distance, with horizontal strata.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright light gray-yellow sky visible above the buildings, tree canopies, and rock face.

entities.name: water surface
entities.identification: The blue-green to gray-green body of water in the lowland on the left side of the passage, with an irregular shoreline.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: The plant growth outside the passage, consisting of grass, shrubs, broad-spreading tree canopies, and tall palms.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: The light yellow-brown sand and gray-brown exposed ground at a lower elevation outside the passage.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: The thick light pink-beige parapet wall on the left side of the passage, with repeated arc-topped stones bearing shallow recessed faces and pale red patterns.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The slender, curved, yellow-brown equipment behind Person A, with visible sections extending above the shoulder and toward the waist, and its middle overlapping the round shield.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The dark round shield on Person A's back, with light-colored curved decorative lines when viewed more frontally and a flattened, narrow projection when Person A leans forward.

entities.name: woven mat
entities.identification: Multiple light brown woven pieces of thin rods on the stone surface, rectangular or irregular in shape, with loose rods along their edges.

entities.name: thin black cable
entities.identification: The thin, curved, black linear cable crossing the exposed rock-surface area on the image-left side.
